guide.title: Quick guide
guide.subtitle: How to use the platform: trainee, instructor and the “Mening Inspektorim” module.

steps.one: Under “Start incident” choose the incident type — the AI Inspector runs the process step by step.
steps.two: Tick checklist items as you go; required documents and legal grounds are in the right panel.
steps.three: The case saves automatically — continue from “My cases”. “Legislation” is the AI reference by article.

guide.slogan: A reliable AI assistant for every inspector. Every decision — grounded in legislation and approved procedures, every process — step by step.

trainee.one: Fill in the profile: full name, badge ID, rank, district. HIMOYA-ID is bound to it.
trainee.two: Pick a scenario under “Trainers”: AI Dialogue, Decision, Smart Mahalla, Documentation or the TIR range.
trainee.three: Speed is not graded — legality and proportionality are. “Correctly not shooting” is also a top mark.
trainee.four: After the session Smart Debriefing opens: what went right, where the mistake was, what to do differently.
trainee.five: HIMOYA-ID updates provisionally; the instructor's confirmation makes it final. History and the radar are in “My sessions”.
trainee.six: “One day of service” is the final exam: 5 stages from 09:00 to 16:30 and a verdict for the whole day.

instructor.one: Choose the “Instructor” role in your profile (with the centre code) — the “Instructor cabinet” appears.
instructor.two: Open pending debriefs in the cabinet, add a note and confirm — only then HIMOYA-ID is finalised.
instructor.three: On the TIR range open the “Instructor station” in a second window: escalate, spawn actors, pause, ALL STOP.
instructor.four: Enter the 30–90 day service result in the “Field service (KPI)” card — it feeds the effectiveness competency.
